mapper.select: SELECT v.C_ID, v.V_NO, v.V_TITLE, v.V_START_DATE, v.V_END_DATE, v.V_START_TIME, v.V_LAST_TIME, v.V_RSTART_DATE, v.V_REND_DATE, v.V_WORKING_DAY, v.SERVICE_CODE, v.V_MAX_AMNT, v.V_REG_AMNT, v.V_UPLOAD_FILE_PATH, v.V_INFO, s.service_type as service_type FROM volunteer v INNER JOIN service_type_table s ON s.service_code = v.service_code WHERE v.V_NO =#{v_no}
select max(v_no) as v_no from volunteer
mapper.update: update volunteer set V_TITLE = #{vTitle}, V_START_DATE = #{vStartDate}, V_END_DATE = #{vEndDate}, V_START_TIME = #{vStartTime}, V_LAST_TIME = #{vLastTime}, V_RSTART_DATE = #{vRStartDate}, V_REND_DATE = #{vREndDate}, V_WORKING_DAY = #{vWorkingDay}, SERVICE_CODE = #{vServiceCode}, V_REG_AMNT = #{vRegAmnt}, V_INFO = #{vInfo}, UPDATED_ID = #{uId}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE where v_no = #{v_no}
mapper.select: SELECT C_NAME, C_ADDR1, C_ADDR2 FROM CENTER_MNG_TABLE WHERE C_ID = #{centerId}

SELECT U.U_ID as userId, U.U_NAME as name, U.U_PHONE as phone, A.REG_RESULT as status, A.REJECT_RS as rejectReason, R.VREG_NO as resNo FROM VOLUNTEER_USER U JOIN VOLUNTEER_REG R ON R.U_ID = U.U_ID JOIN ACCEPTION_RES A ON R.VREG_NO = A.VREG_NO JOIN VOLUNTEER V ON V.V_NO = R.V_NO JOIN CENTER_MNG_TABLE C ON C.C_ID = V.CREATED_ID WHERE V.V_NO = #{v_no} AND R.V_TYPE = 0 AND V.CREATED_ID = #{centerId} ORDER BY V.CREATED_DATE DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VOLUNTEER_USER U JOIN VOLUNTEER_REG R ON R.U_ID = U.U_ID JOIN ACCEPTION_RES A ON R.VREG_NO = A.VREG_NO JOIN VOLUNTEER V ON V.V_NO = R.V_NO JOIN CENTER_MNG_TABLE C ON C.C_ID = V.C_ID WHERE C.C_ID = #{centerId} AND R.V_TYPE = 0
